why: Both are April Fools jokes inside the same sub, distinguished only by whether the sub itself was changed or members posted fakes.

why.T3-009: The item declares the operation a success and celebrates WE DID IT, matching T3-009 rather than mere upkeep.
why.T3-005: It also calls to keep defending and reports vandals/checkerboard pushing into the work, matching T3-005 rather than T3-021 repair.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 alone would not carry the call to keep defending and the reports of vandals and checkerboard pushing into the work after success was declared.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1136031 and C0216112 call for continued defense, satisfying T3-005's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-005 would be dropped first, losing the ongoing defense against attackers.

why.T3-017: Ordinary sub talk and jokes about what users look like during the canvas window, with no canvas work or April Fools fake as its point.

why.T3-023: The moderators staged the Edmond CSS and shitpost day as an April Fools change to the whole sub; fake posts and objections are also present but the changed sub is the frame.

why.T3-073: The item recounts what happened to the small r/MMA logo, its negotiations and survival after the close.
why.T3-072: It thanks allied rooms /r/dwarffortress and Vaporwave and tells the alliance story.
why.T3-043: It credits the room's own participants and leader for the shared achievement.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-073 alone would not carry the act of thanking allied rooms and telling the alliance story as thanks.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0689903 and C0636803 thank /r/dwarffortress and Vaporwave and tell the alliance story, satisfying T3-072's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-072 would be dropped first; the recounting would lose the explicit thanks to allies.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-073 and T3-072 together would still not carry the internal credit to the room's own makers and leader.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0388295 thanks participants and C0107198 thanks the leader, satisfying T3-043's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-043 would be dropped first; the recounting would lose the credit to makers.

why.T3-070: The item posts and updates directions for building HENTAI: border fixes, colour switch, shifting the word, coordinates and refresh instructions, matching T3-070 rather than merely reporting progress.

why.T3-021: Calls to preserve and maintain the LEGO logo as it deteriorates, with the void as threat, match T3-021 watching/repairing rather than upkeep-over-expansion.
